items.text: Hoch kuom jo-Nyasaye
Houru chuny joga, hogiuru,
Nyasachu wacho kamano.
Wuouru gi muolo ne Jerusalem,
kendo uwachne,
ni ndalone mag chandruok oserumo,
bende ni richone osewene,
kendo oseyudo kum nyadiriyo koa e lwet Jehova Nyasaye
nikech richone duto.
Ngʼat moro kok niya:
"Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye,
losneuru Nyasachwa yo moriere tir,
e piny motimo ongoro e thim.
Holo ka holo nobugi mapongʼ,
gode madongo gi matindo duto nopie;
yore motimo gogni nobed maler,
kendo kuonde motimo gode nobed pewe.
Eka duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyre
kendo ji duto biro nene.
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema osewacho kamano."
Dwol moro wacho niya, "Tingʼ dwondi iywagi."
To ne apenjo niya, "Ere gima aywago?"
"Dhano duto chalo gi lum,
kendo bergi duto chalo mana gi maua manie pap.
Lum ner kendo maua tuo mi lwar piny
ka much Jehova Nyasaye okudhogi.
Chutho dhano chalo mana gi lum.
Lum ner kendo maua tuo mi lwar piny,
to wach Nyasachwa osiko manyaka chiengʼ."
In mikelo wach maber ne Sayun,
dhi ewi got malo.
In mikelo wach maber ne Jerusalem,
tingʼ dwondi malo ka ikok matek,
tingʼ dwondi malo, kik ibed maluor;
wach ne mier mag Juda niya,
"Eri Nyasachu nika!"
Neuru, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto biro gi teko,
kendo loch ni e lwete.
Neuru, obiro gi pok mare,
kendo pokne luwo bangʼe.
Orito rombene mana kaka jakwath:
Ochoko nyirombene e bade,
kendo oriwogi e kore
kotelo maber ni rombe man-gi nyithindo.
En ngʼa mosepimo pi e chuny lwete
kata mana pimo lach mar polo gi lwete?
En ngʼa ma osechoko buru manie piny e atonga,
kata pimo gode madongo gi matindo e rapim?
En ngʼa mosefwenyo pach Jehova Nyasaye,
koso en ngʼa mosebedo kaka jangʼadne rieko?
En ngʼa mane Jehova Nyasaye openjo mondo opuonje,
koso en ngʼa mane onyise yo makare?
En ngʼa ma nopuonje rieko
koso en ngʼa mane onyise yor ngʼeyo?
Adier ogendini chalo mana ka pi matin modongʼ e dapi;
ee, gichalo mana ka buru momoko e ratil,
opimo chula mag nembe e ratil mana ka buru mayom.
Yiende mag Lebanon ok oromo moko mach mar kendo mar misango,
kata le man kuno nok ma ok oromo timogo misango miwangʼo pep.
Ogendini duto ok gimoro e nyime,
okwanogi ka gik manono,
maonge tich.
En ngʼa ma dipim gi Nyasaye?
Koso en kido mane madiwach ni chal kode?
To nyiseche manono, jatheth nyalo loso
kendo jatheth nyalo bawe gi dhahabu,
mi olosne thiwni mar fedha.
Ngʼat modhier ma ok nyal golo chiwo machalo kama,
yiero yien ma ok tow.
Omanyo japecho molony
mondo olosne kido ma ok nyal podho piny.
Donge ungʼeyo
Koso donge usewinjo?
Pok owachnu nyaka aa chakruok?
Koso pok wachno odonjonu nyaka ne chwe pinyni.
Nyasaye obet e kom duongʼne kuma bor moyombo piny
kendo joma ni e polo ngʼeny machalo kama ongogo ochokoree.
Oyaro polo mana ka tipo maduongʼ
kendo oyarogi mana ka hema midakie.
Odwoko ruodhi piny
kendo omiyo jotelo duto mag pinyni bet kanono.
Ka okudhogi gi muche to giner
mi kalausi dhi kodgi ka mihudhwe,
nikech gichalo gi kodhi mokom machiegni,
ma tiendgi pok ochwowo lowo.
Nyasaye Maler penjo niya, "En ngʼa madupima-go?
Koso en ngʼa madirom koda?"
Tingʼuru wengeu malo kendo ungʼi polo:
En ngʼa manochweyo gigi duto?
Donge en ema nomiyo sulwe manie kor polo obetie kokelogi achiel kachiel,
koluongo moro ka moro gi nyinge.
Onge moro kuomgi molal
nikech tekone duongʼ kod nyalone.
Yaye joka Jakobo angʼo momiyo uwuoyo,
angʼo momiyo ungʼur, yaye jo-Israel,
kuwacho niya, "Jehova Nyasaye ok dew yorena;
kendo ni yorena ok okwan ka gimoro gi Nyasacha."
Donge ungʼeyo?
Koso pok uwinjo?
Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye manyaka chiengʼ
kendo Jachwech mar piny duto.
Ok nobed mool bende ok nonyosre,
kendo pache onge ngʼama nyalo ngʼeyo.
Omiyo joma ool teko
kendo omedo joma tekregi orumo bedo motegno.
Jomatindo nyalo bedo mool mi nyosre,
kendo yawuowi nyalo chwanyore mi podhi,
to joma oketo genogi kuom Jehova Nyasaye
tekregi nodwogi.
Gibiro huyo mana ka ongo mafuyo gi bwombe;
gibiro ringo to ok gibi bedo mool,
bende gibiro wuotho to tekregi ok norum.
